built: Seven steps that do nothing, or need no procedure, on their usual result now keep only their basic content in the skill bodies, and their procedure moves, unchanged word for word, to a reference file beside the skill: the commit step and the chain end step in every body that carries them, archive's gate prompt, divergence check and sign-off hold, architect's program sign-off hold, propose's size brief, and the placement notes of the PR sections in propose, ff and architect. The bodies shrink from about 434,000 to 389,374 characters, apply's to 27,124. A budget test now fails any body that grows past its size plus 5% or over 500 lines (explore held at 664), naming a new root file, skill_body_convention.md, that says how to fix it; a size report runs in CI and never fails. The README and the supported-tools page now say fourteen workflows carry reference files, not eight.
seams: None. No new question is asked and no setting changes what happens; every workflow reads the same text as before, from a reference file when its command returns anything but the usual result.
deviations: None from the charter. Some phrases that point by position moved unchanged with their text and now read oddly in their reference files, though they stay true of the step read whole: the design lists each one so stage tighten-bodies can reword them, among them the arc-done paragraph that names the reference it now sits in and the gate prompt's "this body". The shared PR reference for propose and ff grew past 100 lines with no table of contents, a new case of what RG2 forbids, left to tighten-bodies, which owns RG2. The rule that each body names every reference file directly holds everywhere except two review references reached through another reference, a gap that predates this stage and is also left to tighten-bodies.
detail: Measured at apply on 2026-11-17 (orbit 2.0.2, generateSkillContent): total 389,374 against the design estimate of about 389,400; apply 27,124 (design about 27,000). Block hashes recorded before any template edit (task 1.1) hold in test/core/templates/moved-blocks.test.ts. The positional phrases named in design Risks stay as accepted. The system walk on 2026-11-17 made archive Step 3.7's basic content hand over the save's outcome with the hold's result, as architect 5.4's does, and corrected design's RG1 gap to about 2,700.
